decision_rule: Promote if expectancy >= +0.05 R AND consistency is 4/4 years positive. Compare against r3b-short-only: if r3b dominates on recovery factor, the asymmetry hypothesis is refuted.
hypothesis: The direction effect is an asymmetry in evidence quality, not a reason to ban one side: requiring LONG to clear volume_spike and low OB ambiguity captures most of the SHORT advantage while keeping a long book.
